# ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops Daily Update (Jan 6, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
The day saw a new issue opened to improve the `addGameType` template by pulling contract addresses on-chain, aiming for less error-prone reviews. An active discussion continued regarding the `SyncStatus CurrentL1 Selection` in Kona, and a question about OP Stack compatibility with minimal contracts was closed.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

No new technical developments were completed today.

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
No new pull requests were opened today.

## CLOSED ISSUES

### Clarification on OP Stack Smart Contract Compatibility
An inquiry regarding OP Stack compatibility with minimal Solidity contracts, similar to those deployed on Base, was addressed and closed. The response confirmed that smart contracts generally function as expected, with a reference provided to documentation outlining differences from L1 Ethereum. ([#18709](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/18709))

## NEW ISSUES

### Template Improvement for Game Type Addition
A new issue was opened to enhance the `addGameType` template. The proposed improvement involves fetching all necessary contract addresses directly on-chain via the SystemConfig, which is expected to reduce review tedium and potential errors. ([#1330](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/1330))

## ACTIVE ISSUES

### Kona SyncStatus CurrentL1 Selection Revision
Discussion continued on an issue concerning the `optimism_syncStatus` RPC endpoint in Kona, where `current_l1` is incorrectly set to the latest L1 head instead of the actual derivation cursor. A recent comment highlighted the importance of fixing this without introducing additional communication channels, referencing a design document and an example of channel consolidation for guidance. ([#18673](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/18673))
